description: C9 stability - 50 sequential webhooks, p95 latency, no state bleed and no goroutine leak.

cases.name: C9 50 sequential webhooks on a disposable local m9m: p95, stable body, goroutine count
cases.notes: The disposable instance owns its own workflow, so the probe never touches shared state. The goroutine check reads go_goroutines from the Prometheus endpoint before and after the burst. Measured 2026-11-12: the local /metrics endpoint serves only the m9m_up gauge, so go_goroutines is absent and the leak check reports 'goroutine metrics unavailable'. Missing piece (runtime, outside this task's file ownership): internal/monitoring must register the Prometheus Go collector (prometheus.NewGoCollector) so /metrics exports go_goroutines. p95 latency and the no-state-bleed assertion (identical body across all 50 runs) are fully checked today.

cases.name: C9 50 sequential webhooks against the shared m9m: p95 and stable body
cases.notes: Read-only webhook POSTs against the shared deployment. The goroutine metric is not exposed there (no metrics port), so the leak check is covered by c901.
